description:
The CT Cranium DICOM dataset is already loaded. A dental researcher needs a specific model of the alveolar structures. 

1. Create a segmentation mask using a CUSTOM threshold range of 150 HU to 700 HU (do not use a preset).
2. Generate a 3D surface from this mask.
3. Save the project to '/home/ga/Documents/alveolar_study.inv3'.
4. Export the 3D surface as a binary STL file to '/home/ga/Documents/alveolar_surface.stl'.
